name: Shield of the Void
legend: The Reclamation of Ultramar saw the Shield Chapters conquer countless threats in the void with the tactically divergent warriors at hand. They alloyed these into lethal ly effective forces that struck at enemy vessels using coordinated aggression and methodical precision to purge the foe deck by deck.

rules.name: Focused Response
rules.legend: The battle-brothers of the Shield Chapters commit their boarding strikes with a measured and meticulous application of force. They storm one section after the next while maintaining heightened awareness of lurking threats, and readying themselves to launch devastating counterattacks.
rules.description_html:
• Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
  • Each time an enemy unit makes an attack that targets an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is Set To Defend, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE PURGE
stratagems.type: Shield of the Void – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Whatever hidden horrors lurk in the vessels the Shield Chapters must conquer, the warriors are able to adapt their firing tactics to ensure their destruction.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one of the following abilities: [LETHAL HITS], [IGNORES COVER] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability.

stratagems.name: RAPID TAKEOVER
stratagems.type: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: With one foe reeling in disarray, the battle-brothers instantly refocus on their next target, their rapid yet methodical progress capitalising on the enemy's every move.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+1".

stratagems.name: CODEX WARFARE
stratagems.type: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: The Codex Astartes is held as a hallowed work of martial genius by the Shield Chapters. Its tenets prescribe tactical adaptability and fighting on the move, advancing from one adversary to the next in a series of deadly redeployments.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
stratagems.description_text:

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.

stratagems.name: OVERCHARGED BREACH
stratagems.type: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: With a well-placed volley of high-powered ammunition or a dedicated melta charge, specially equipped Space Marines can effect a permanent access route.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one closed Hatchway within 9" of and visible to your unit. Open that Hatchway and, until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once.

enhancements.name: Speartip of the Chapter
enhancements.legend: A veteran of countless boarding strikes, this warrior leads their battle-brothers in a vanguard breach that drives into the foe's heart.
enhancements.description_html: At the start of the first battle round, the bearer’s unit and up to one other friendly unit within the same Entry Zone can each make a Normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Tolorek Data Djinn
enhancements.legend: Gifted by the Tech-Priests of Tolorek for the cleansing of Ultramar, this powerful cyberspirit uses brute force technoscreed when entreated to overwhelm the systems of enemy ships, conquering them and yoking their protocols to the bearer's will.
enhancements.description_html: In your Command phase, select one objective marker that you control and is within range of the bearer. Roll one D6: on a 2+, that objective marker is Secured by your army.
